import unittest

from solution import BoundedHistory


class BoundedHistoryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_and_append_return_value(self):
        history = BoundedHistory(2)
        first = history.items()
        second = history.items()
        self.assertEqual(first, [])
        self.assertIsNot(first, second)
        self.assertIsNone(history.append("a"))
        self.assertEqual(history.items(), ["a"])

    def test_keeps_only_most_recent_values_in_order(self):
        history = BoundedHistory(3)
        for value in ["a", "b", "c"]:
            history.append(value)
        self.assertEqual(history.items(), ["a", "b", "c"])

        history.append("d")
        self.assertEqual(history.items(), ["b", "c", "d"])
        history.append("e")
        self.assertEqual(history.items(), ["c", "d", "e"])

    def test_capacity_one_evicts_exactly_oldest(self):
        history = BoundedHistory(1)
        history.append(1)
        self.assertEqual(history.items(), [1])
        history.append(2)
        self.assertEqual(history.items(), [2])

    def test_append_deep_copies_input(self):
        value = {"nested": [1, {"letters": ["a"]}]}
        history = BoundedHistory(2)
        history.append(value)

        value["nested"][1]["letters"].append("changed")
        value["nested"].append(99)
        self.assertEqual(
            history.items(),
            [{"nested": [1, {"letters": ["a"]}]}],
        )

    def test_items_returns_deep_copy_each_time(self):
        history = BoundedHistory(2)
        history.append({"values": [[1, 2]]})

        returned = history.items()
        returned[0]["values"][0].append(3)
        returned.append("extra")

        self.assertEqual(history.items(), [{"values": [[1, 2]]}])
        self.assertIsNot(history.items(), history.items())

    def test_invalid_capacity_type(self):
        for capacity in [True, False, 1.0, "1", None]:
            with self.subTest(capacity=capacity):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    BoundedHistory(capacity)

    def test_non_positive_capacity(self):
        for capacity in [0, -1, -100]:
            with self.subTest(capacity=capacity):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    BoundedHistory(capacity)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
